summary: Tested all 4 new features: Admin cancellation (no reason, no notification), Main Building Exclusivity toggle, Event Blocking CRUD module, and Password change/forgot password. All 16 backend tests passed. All UI elements verified working.

issues: Console warnings about chart dimensions (-1 width/height) - cosmetic only, pre-existing issue

critical_code_review_comments: Missing DialogContent aria-describedby warning in Event Blocking dialog - minor accessibility issue
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 new features verified working: 1) Admin cancel at PUT /api/admin/reservations/{id}/cancel - no reason required, no user notification. 2) Main building exclusivity toggle on Parking Config page - saves and retrieves correctly. 3) Event Blocking CRUD - creates reservation records with booking_type='event_block', rejects overlapping slots. 4) Password features - forgot password creates admin notification, change password requires current_password for non-forced changes.
